SELECT ?compName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE {
  ?c rc:affectsComponent ?comp .
  ?comp rc:name ?compName .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?child skos:broader ?comp }
  ?c rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name ?mkName .
  FILTER(?mkName IN ("HYUNDAI","KIA"))
}
GROUP BY ?comp ?compName
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?mkName) = 2)
ORDER BY DESC(?n)
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT ?campno WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campno ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:modelYear ?y ; rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:name "SANTA FE" ; rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name "HYUNDAI" . FILTER(STR(?y)="2021") } ORDER BY ?campno

SELECT DISTINCT ?genesisModel WHERE {
  ?k rc:affects ?kv . ?kv rc:ofModel ?km . ?km rc:name "TELLURIDE" ; rc:ofMake ?kmake . ?kmake rc:name "KIA" .
  ?k rc:affectsComponent ?c .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?cn), ":"))
  ?c rc:name ?cn .
  ?g rc:affectsComponent ?c ; rc:affects ?gv .
  ?gv rc:ofModel ?gm . ?gm rc:ofMake ?gmake . ?gmake rc:name "GENESIS" .
  ?gm rc:name ?genesisModel .
} ORDER BY ?genesisModel
SELECT ?modelName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:name ?modelName . } GROUP BY ?m ?modelName ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 5

SELECT ?topName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?model) AS ?modelCount) WHERE {
  ?r rc:affectsComponent ?c .
  ?c skos:broader* ?top .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?top skos:broader ?p }
  ?top rc:name ?topName .
  ?r rc:affects ?v .
  ?v rc:ofModel ?model .
}
GROUP BY ?topName
ORDER BY DESC(?modelCount)
LIMIT 5
SELECT ?campNo ?pa WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:parkOutside true ; rc:potentiallyAffected ?pa ; rc:campaignNumber ?campNo . } ORDER BY DESC(?pa) LIMIT 1
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?count) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:initiatedBy ?i . FILTER(CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?i)), "ODI")) }

SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:reportReceivedDate ?d ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name ?mn . FILTER(UCASE(STR(?mn)) IN ("HYUNDAI","KIA","GENESIS")) BIND(YEAR(?d) AS ?year) } GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1
